title: Tmall Officially Launches AI Space Station: Alibaba Cloud, Zhipu, Kimi, and MiniMax Jointly Join
excerpt: The consumer-level popularization of domestic large model services has reached an important milestone. On September 3, Tmall officially launched a new AI space
content_html:
The consumer-level popularization of domestic large model services has reached an important milestone. On September 3, Tmall officially launched a new AI space station (Token recharge center), for the first time fully integrating standardized subscription services from multiple leading large model manufacturers into the mainstream e-commerce ecosystem, allowing ordinary consumers to purchase AI products as conveniently as buying daily mobile phone data or recharging phone credit.

The newly launched AI recharge center integrates core resources from leading domestic large model manufacturers such as Alibaba Cloud, Zhipu, Kimi, and MiniMax. In terms of specific product matrices, the platform not only includes flexible period-based subscription plans such as Token Plan and Coding Plan, but also provides recharge schemes that cater to different usage intensities, and fully supports two efficient and convenient delivery methods: card codes or direct recharge. The day before, Zhipu announced its official entry onto Tmall by opening an official flagship store and launching related subscription packages; on the first day of opening, the search volume for related products surged by an astonishing 40 times compared to the previous period.

For ordinary users, the threshold for accessing and using large models is being lowered in an unprecedented way. Users just need to open the Taobao App, enter "token" in the search bar, and click "Buy Now" to directly reach the dedicated venue, or find the "AI Model" entry through the "More" option in the "Recharge Center" to make a purchase. This approach of bringing large model services to traditional e-commerce platforms marks that AI commercialization is accelerating from a single developer direct sales and official website subscriptions to a broader national-level consumer market.

Industry analysts point out that the collective entry of large model manufacturers into mainstream e-commerce platforms goes beyond simply adding an online sales channel. E-commerce ecosystems represented by Tmall flagship stores and centralized recharge centers have successfully transformed originally complex AI services into standardized, self-purchasable, and auto-renewable mature products. This model not only makes the purchasing process extremely intuitive, but also provides mainstream mass consumers with an opportunity to access all-in-one AI tools in one place.

In addition to virtual model services and token recharge businesses, Tmall's layout in the field of physical AI smart hardware is also continuously accelerating. Currently, the platform has been rapidly launching new computer models pre-installed with Agent intelligences, smart learning machines equipped with the Qwen large model, smart speakers, and AI glasses among several cutting-edge categories. By deeply integrating online large model token services with offline smart hardware, Tmall is committed to creating a comprehensive one-stop AI consumer experience covering both software and hardware.
